## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/dotgraphtraits">DOTGraphTraits</a> - Template class that can be specialized to customize how graphs are converted to 'dot' graphs.</p>


<p>When specializing, you may inherit from <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/defaultdotgraphtraits">DefaultDOTGraphTraits</a> if you don't need to override everything.</p>


<p>Definition at line 166 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/support/dotgraphtraits-h">DOTGraphTraits.h</a>.</p>
